Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.CombinedEnvelopeResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.CombinedEnvelopeResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy
public static final class ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.CombinedEnvelopeResult extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable result of evaluating exact baseline slice definitions under one combined capacity configuration.

Baseline slices are retained as immutable templates and are never resampled. Relieved slices use the same exact study, axes, grids, and anchors while all declared capacity alternatives are active together. The result is qualified only after reverse-order capacity restoration and process reconvergence.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team
